scripts.text: I wish all of you joy
^3355FFLutie^000000, the fantastic Christmas Town! Always filled with the spirit of giving, Lutie is filled with appetizing cakes, tiny toy soldiers, and all sorts of wonderful things~!
scripts.translation: ^3355FF薑餅城^000000是奇妙的聖誕小鎮！這裡總是洋溢著分享的精神，到處都是美味蛋糕、小小玩具士兵和各種美好的事物~！

scripts.text: It's an amazing land blessed with the beauty of winter, and a year round atmosphere of festivity!
scripts.translation: 這是一片被冬日美景眷顧的神奇土地，終年洋溢著節日氣氛！

scripts.text: I'm a Santa that will guide people to Lutie, the Christmas Town. Ask me at any time, and I'll magically send you there~
scripts.translation: 我是負責帶大家前往聖誕小鎮薑餅城的聖誕老人。想去的話，隨時告訴我，我會用魔法送你過去~

scripts.text: The only way to get to Lutie is here in Al de Baran!
scripts.translation: 去薑餅城的唯一入口就在艾爾帕蘭！

scripts.text: I keep this place and personally transport people who want to visit Lutie. Please ask Santa Claus over there if you want to leave town. He will let you know the way out of Lutie.
scripts.translation: 我守在這裡，親自送想去薑餅城的人過去。想離開薑餅城時，請問問那邊的聖誕老人，他會告訴你怎麼出去。

scripts.text: Whenever you want to visit Lutie, be my guest. Just let me know when you want to leave.
scripts.translation: 想來薑餅城時，隨時歡迎。想離開時告訴我一聲就行。

scripts.text: I'm Santa Claus, and I bring gifts to every good boy and girl on Christmas!
scripts.translation: 我是聖誕老人，會在聖誕節給每個乖巧的男孩女孩送禮物！

scripts.text: If you want to leave Lutie, go outside town and head south to the first field that you see. You'll be able to find a magical warp that will take you to Al de Baran.
scripts.translation: 想離開薑餅城的話，走出城鎮向南前往第一個野外區域。在那裡你會找到一個魔法傳送門，通往艾爾帕蘭。

scripts.text: Hey, have you heard that here in Lutie, we have an attraction that's equally as famous as Santa himself?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你聽說了嗎？薑餅城有個和聖誕老人一樣有名的景點！

scripts.text: Before you leave, you really should meet and talk to Snowysnow, even if it's only once. He's really a nice guy and fun to talk to.
scripts.translation: 在你離開之前，真的應該去見見雪雪，哪怕只是聊一次也好。他是個很好的人，和他聊天很有趣。

scripts.text: Have you ever talked to the snowman in front of this town? The lonely snowman who stands in solitude...
scripts.translation: 你和鎮前的雪人聊過嗎？就是那個孤零零站著的雪人...

scripts.text: But he's so warm hearted~! Sometimes, I talk to Snowysnow the snowman. For some weird reason, he can talk just like us!
scripts.translation: 不過，他的心可暖和了~！我有時會和雪人雪雪聊天。不知道為什麼，他竟然能像我們一樣說話！

scripts.text: When I talk to Snowysnow, I get to wondering how he came to be. I guess if you talk to him too, you'll feel the same way.
scripts.translation: 每次和雪雪聊天，我都會好奇他是怎麼誕生的。我想你和他聊過之後，也會有同樣的感覺。

scripts.text: How he was created, and how he thinks and talks like a human is such a mystery...
scripts.translation: 他是如何被創造出來的？為什麼能像人類一樣思考和說話？真是個謎...

scripts.text: Where did he come from and what kind of place was it? And how did he come to Lutie without any legs...?
scripts.translation: 他從哪裡來？那是個什麼樣的地方？他連腿都沒有，是怎麼來到薑餅城的...？

scripts.text: Lately, it seems more and more people are coming to this town to see Snowysnow.
scripts.translation: 最近，來鎮上看雪雪的人似乎越來越多。

scripts.text: I guess you should talk to the other people living in Lutie if you want to learn more about the mystery of Snowysnow...
scripts.translation: 想了解更多關於雪雪的謎團，我想你應該和薑餅城的其他居民聊聊...

scripts.text: While you're here, don't forget to visit the original Santa Claus here in Lutie.
scripts.translation: 既然來了，別忘了去見見薑餅城真正的聖誕老人。

scripts.text: I know what he thinks... Ho ho ho~! He intends to make me feel happy so that I'll give him some free jars of pickles! Oh well~!
scripts.translation: 我知道他在想什麼...呵呵呵~！他故意讓我開心，好讓我送他幾罐免費的醃菜！算了~！

scripts.text: He knows me too well. I almost can't stop from giving that man some pickles. Yes, even I know my pickles are the best in town!
scripts.translation: 他太瞭解我了。我幾乎忍不住要給他一些醃菜。沒錯，我也知道自己的醃菜是鎮上最好的！

scripts.text: Well, I can't just let anyone know something so important about Snowysnow. Hmmm...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我不能隨便把雪雪這麼重要的事告訴任何人...

scripts.text: Snowysnow has been holding something for me as a favor, the ^3355FFroughest salt in the world^000000 which I use to pickle cabbages.
scripts.translation: 雪雪幫我保管著一樣東西，就是^3355FF世界上最粗的鹽^000000，我用它來醃捲心菜。

scripts.text: I suppose if you're really Snowysnow's friend, he will trust you enough to give it to you so you can deliver it to me. And in any case, I'll need more of it soon.
scripts.translation: 如果你真是雪雪的朋友，他一定會信任你，把鹽交給你帶回來。正好，我也快要用完了。

scripts.text: You are really a scatter-brained person, my dear. Now hurry over to Snowysnow and bring me the ^3355FFroughest salt in the world^000000.
scripts.translation: 親愛的，你可真是個馬大哈。快去雪雪那裡，把^3355FF世界上最粗的鹽^000000給我拿回來。

scripts.text: Now I am able to pickle my cabbages properly. Thank you, my dear. Thank you...
scripts.translation: 現在我可以好好醃捲心菜了。謝謝你，親愛的，謝謝你...

scripts.text: Oh yes, I'm sorry. I almost forgot what I promised you. You asked me about Snowysnow's magical gift bag, didn't you?
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，抱歉。我差點忘了答應你的事。你之前問過雪雪的魔法禮物袋，對吧？

scripts.text: If you already met Uncle Cantata, you must know by now that Snowysnow has been made out of some mysterious snow that covered a thick field of magical flowers.
scripts.translation: 如果你已經見過康塔塔叔叔，就該知道雪雪是由覆蓋著一大片魔法花朵的神秘積雪做成的。

scripts.text: I can't tell you how, but when Snowysnow was revived, there was a reaction between the Alchemist's materials and the energies of Snowysnow's snow.
scripts.translation: 我也說不清是怎麼回事，不過雪雪甦醒時，鍊金術士的材料和他身上積雪的能量發生了反應。

scripts.text: For some reason, Snowysnow's gift bag can now create as many presents as Snowysnow wants, just like Santa Claus.
scripts.translation: 不知為何，雪雪的禮物袋現在能像聖誕老人的一樣，想變出多少禮物就變出多少。

scripts.text: Of course, if this power were to fall into the hands of evil, we would all be in trouble.
scripts.translation: 當然，如果這種力量落入壞人手中，我們就麻煩大了。

scripts.text: However, everyone knows that Snowysnow is kind and loving towards others. So we're never worried about Snowysnow's powers.
scripts.translation: 不過，大家都知道雪雪對別人充滿善意和愛心。所以我們從不擔心他的力量。

scripts.text: Oh, and I've just heard some shocking news from ^3355FFHashokii^000000 the clown. It's quite an interesting story, actually. Why don't you ask him more about it?
scripts.translation: 哦，我剛從搞笑藝人^3355FF哈紹基^000000那裡聽到一個驚人的訊息。其實這故事很有意思，你去問問他吧。

scripts.text: I can feel the Christmas spirit all around me! It's even in the eyes of the young travelers who've come out here all the way to Lutie. Hoho, I wish you a Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation: 我能感受到四周濃濃的聖誕氣息！就連遠道來到薑餅城的年輕旅人，眼中也閃爍著光芒。呵呵，祝你聖誕快樂！

scripts.text: 'Christmas dungeon' around here. Well, I guess I don't need to tell you much if you've heard about it already.
scripts.translation: 叫“聖誕地牢”的地方。你要是已經聽說過，我就不多說了。

scripts.text: I figured something out a few days ago. In the Christmas dungeon, you'll run into creatures that are similar to those outside of town.
scripts.translation: 幾天前我發現，聖誕地牢裡的生物和鎮外的那些很像。

scripts.text: I'm guessing that monsters wandered here from outside of town, and were changed by the cold weather here. So monsters adapted to live in this environment.
scripts.translation: 我猜那些魔物是從鎮外遊蕩來的，被這裡的寒冷天氣改變後，逐漸適應了這個環境。

scripts.text: Okay, now I think I better be ready to pickle some cabbages. If you didn't know already, I make the best pickles around! Why don't you visit me later and try some?
scripts.translation: 好了，我得準備醃捲心菜了。你可能還不知道，我做的醃菜可是這一帶最好吃的！改天來嚐嚐吧？

scripts.text: He's a snowman that doesn't have any legs. No wonder he hasn't come to visit me. What a shame, what a shame. I guess I better go visit him instead.
scripts.translation: 原來他是個沒有腿的雪人。難怪他沒來拜訪我。真遺憾...看來還是我去拜訪他吧。

scripts.text: Oh, there is someone who knows how Snowysnow came to be able to speak. That person would be ^3355FFUncle Hairy Cantata^000000...
scripts.translation: 哦，有個人知道雪雪為什麼會說話。那就是^3355FF毛茸茸的康塔塔大叔^000000...

scripts.text: One day when apprentice of the great alchemist visited Lutie, I came to listen in on a conversation between him and Uncle Hairy.
scripts.translation: 有一天，一位偉大鍊金術士的學徒來到薑餅城，我正好聽到了他和康塔塔大叔的對話。

scripts.text: Long ago, a great alchemist came by Snowysnow's hometown and happened to meet Snowysnow dying, melting down into water. However, Snowysnow was miraculously revived by that Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 很久以前，一位偉大的鍊金術士路過雪雪的家鄉，遇見了奄奄一息、正融化成水的雪雪。後來，雪雪奇蹟般地被那位鍊金術士救活了。

scripts.text: But that's pretty much all I know. For the actual details, you should ask ^3355FFUncle Hairy Cantata^000000.
scripts.translation: 不過我知道的就這些。想了解詳情的話，你應該去問^3355FF毛茸茸的康塔塔大叔^000000。

scripts.text: Here in this magical land of fun and fancy, you can enjoy the spirit of Christmas all year round~! Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation: 在這片充滿魔法與樂趣的土地上，全年都能感受聖誕氣氛~！是不是很美妙？

scripts.text: Lutie isn't merely just a simple attraction. We have convenient facilities like the other towns, but in a festive environment.
scripts.translation: 薑餅城可不只是個景點。這裡設施齊全，和其他城鎮一樣便利，還充滿節日氣氛。

scripts.text: So if you decide to stay here for a while, you should have all the comforts that you need. Merry Christmas~
scripts.translation: 所以想在這裡多待一陣也沒問題，生活所需一應俱全。聖誕快樂~

scripts.text: Oh? Y-y-you've got the stuff? Goooooooood. It's been so long since I've been able to have some of this... G-give it to me!
scripts.translation: 哦？你...你帶來了？太...太好了。我已經很久沒吃到這個了...快...快給我！

scripts.text: ^3355FFYou quickly handed him the Squid Ink and Sticky Mucus and watched with a little disgust as he relished the flavor.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你迅速把墨汁和粘稠液體遞給他，看著他陶醉地品嚐，心裡不禁有些厭惡。^000000

scripts.text: Well, now it's the time for my story. Keep in mind that this is the whole story from what I know. I'm not sure how much you've already heard though...
scripts.translation: 好了，現在該講我的故事了。這就是我所知道的全部，不過不知道你已經聽說了多少...

scripts.text: He was always foremost in the research of alchemy and needed rare materials to conduct his studies. Because of that, he had to travel the world in search of materials containing magical energies...
scripts.translation: 他的鍊金術研究一直走在最前沿，需要許多稀有材料。因此，他四處旅行，尋找蘊含魔法能量的材料...

scripts.text: One day, his travels brought him to a northern village known for its freezing weather. But when he arrived, he was welcomed by a smouldering town that had recently been destroyed.
scripts.translation: 有一天，他的旅行將他帶到了一座以嚴寒著稱的北方村莊。但當他到達時，迎接他的是一座剛剛被摧毀、仍在冒煙的城鎮。

scripts.text: It was a grim sight: People were lying at the roadside, groaning in agony. As Varsez walked by, each villager would beg, 'K-Kill me...' and plead for him to put them out of their misery.
scripts.translation: 那是一幅悽慘的景象：人們躺在路邊，痛苦地呻吟著。當瓦瑟茲走過時，每個村民都會乞求道：“殺...殺了我吧...”，懇求他結束他們的痛苦。

scripts.text: Amidst the woeful cries of despair, the wails of two infants reached the ears of Philip Varsez. He rushed to investigate and found two babies cushioned in the bosom of a melting snowman.
scripts.translation: 在絕望的哀嚎聲中，兩個嬰兒的哭聲傳入了菲利普·瓦瑟茲的耳中。他急忙趕去檢視，發現兩個嬰兒被安置在一個正在融化的雪人懷中。

scripts.text: Being the wise Alchemist that he is, Varsez deduced that Snowysnow sacrificed himself to protect those two babies from the great disaster that had destroyed the village.
scripts.translation: 睿智的鍊金術士瓦瑟茲推斷，雪雪為了保護那兩個嬰兒，在摧毀村莊的大災難中犧牲了自己。

scripts.text: Varsez was touched, and was determined to save the life of this snowman with his alchemy. He would then transport him here to Lutie, the safest place in the world.
scripts.translation: 瓦瑟茲深受感動，決心用鍊金術救活這個雪人，再把他送到世界上最安全的地方——薑餅城。

scripts.text: Of course, there was another rumor that, in addition to the mercy from that Alchemist, Snowysnow was able to survive due to the special properties of his snow.
scripts.translation: 當然，也有另一種說法：除了那位鍊金術士的幫助，雪雪能活下來還因為他的雪有特殊性質。

scripts.text: It's believed that Snowysnow's snow used to cover a mysterious field that would be filled with the bloom of magical flowers.
scripts.translation: 據說，雪雪身上的雪曾覆蓋著一片神秘的田野，那裡開滿了魔法花朵。

scripts.text: Well, that's pretty much all I know. I hope you were able to learn what you wanted from my story! Haw haw haw!
scripts.translation: 嗯，我知道的大概就是這些了。希望我的故事能讓你瞭解到想知道的事！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Now that I think about it...
Snowysnow can not only speak, but he also seems to be able to create an endless supply of Christmas presents. Or at least, that's what I hear.
scripts.translation: 雪雪不但會說話，似乎還能變出無窮無盡的聖誕禮物。至少我是這麼聽說的。

scripts.text: ^3355FFThachentze^000000, that lovely pickle maker, knows more about it. So if you're curious, you should go talk to her. Alrighty then, Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation: ^3355FF塔琴策^000000，那位可愛的醃菜師傅知道得更多。好奇的話就去問問她吧。好了，聖誕快樂！

scripts.text: Oh yeah? Heard about me from Poze, did you? Haw haw haw! Yeah, I know a little bit about Snowysnow. In fact, I may even be his weak point, since...
scripts.translation: 哦？波澤跟你提到我了？哈哈哈！沒錯，我對雪雪瞭解一些。事實上，我甚至可能是他的弱點，因為...

scripts.text: Heh heh heh~ Well, don't think I'll let you know unless you give me something in return!
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿嘿~別以為我會免費告訴你，除非你給我點回報！

scripts.text: much of a chance to enjoy
a man's drink. Hmmm, bring me...
Wahhahaha! What the hell is that look for?! Never you mind my gourmet sense of taste! Now get to work~!
scripts.translation: 哇哈哈！你這是什麼表情？！別管我的美食家品味了！快去幹活~！

scripts.text: It looks like the cold has brought a rosiness to your cheeks.
scripts.translation: 看來寒冷讓你的臉頰紅撲撲的。

scripts.text: Be careful, it wouldn't be good for you to catch the Lutie Flu.
scripts.translation: 小心點，染上薑餅城流感可不好。

scripts.text: My little boy had a terrible case of the Lutie Flu a while ago.
scripts.translation: 前陣子，我兒子得了很嚴重的薑餅城流感。

scripts.text: It was during the night, and there was no place I could get any medicine. It seemed I could do nothing for my little boy.
scripts.translation: 那天晚上，我找不到任何能買到藥的地方，感覺自己什麼也幫不了兒子。

scripts.text: I thought the least I could do for my son was get something cold to bring down his fever, but the snow of Lutie kept on melting after being placed on his forehead. He was burning up, and I was failing to relieve him.
scripts.translation: 我想至少能找點冷東西給兒子退燒，可薑餅城的雪放在他額頭上很快就融化了。他燒得厲害，我卻沒法讓他好受些。

scripts.text: Eventually, I found myself in the Christmas dungeon without any goal in mind. Inside I found, thank God, a certain creature made entirely of ice!
scripts.translation: 後來，我漫無目的地走進聖誕地牢。謝天謝地，我在裡面發現了一種完全由冰構成的生物！

scripts.text: It was an ^3355FFIceporing^000000! The local people used to call it 'Icepantzering.' Anyway, I was able to save my boy's life with it. Thank goodness something like that was around in this town.
scripts.translation: 那是一隻^3355FF冰波利^000000！當地人以前叫它“冰波利”。總之，我靠它救了兒子的命。謝天謝地，鎮上有這種生物。

scripts.text: Oops, I think I've talked a bit much. Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我好像說得有點多。聖誕快樂~！

scripts.text: Day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day...
scripts.translation: 一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天，一天又一天...

scripts.text: I was born in an area to the north where it snowed all the time, and was much colder than Lutie, if you can believe that.
scripts.translation: 我出生在北方一個終年下雪的地方。你可能不信，那裡比薑餅城還冷。

scripts.text: I was made with love by a human, and I was really happy there. Life was simple, but it was full of quiet bliss.
scripts.translation: 一個人類滿懷愛意地堆出了我。我在那裡過得很快樂，日子雖然簡單，卻安寧幸福。

scripts.text: I thought I could live the rest of my life in that kind of contentment. But... It was not to be.
scripts.translation: 我以為能一直這樣心滿意足地生活下去。可是...事與願違。

scripts.text: One fateful day, some ugly old woman came to our town. People say her name was 'Merlophechum,' and that she was from some strange cave town where the weather was always hot.
scripts.translation: 災難發生那天，一個醜陋的老婦人來到了鎮上。人們說她叫“梅洛菲丘姆”，來自一個奇怪的洞穴城鎮，那裡總是很熱。

scripts.text: On the third night she was there, she set the town on fire with frightening magic. Everyone was running in panic amongst the fear and chaos. And somehow, I was knocked out.
scripts.translation: 她來到鎮上的第三個晚上，用可怕的魔法放火燒了鎮子。大家驚慌逃竄，一片混亂。不知怎麼的，我也昏了過去。

scripts.text: I didn't notice how much time passed after that, but when I woke up, I was here. Well, I can say that this place, Lutie, is pretty much like heaven.
scripts.translation: 我不知道過了多久，醒來時已經在這裡了。薑餅城簡直就像天堂。

scripts.text: Everyone here is never worried, and I'm always hearing Christmas carols and stuff.
scripts.translation: 這裡的人無憂無慮，我總能聽到聖誕頌歌。

scripts.text: Sometimes all that Christmas joy somehow doesn't cure the dark loneliness that wells deep inside of me.
scripts.translation: 有時，聖誕的歡樂也驅不散我心底湧起的孤獨。

scripts.text: So will you be my friend? If you do, I'll be your friend too~
scripts.translation: 那麼，你願意做我的朋友嗎？如果你願意，我也會做你的朋友~

scripts.text: It's weird that the people of Lutie call me a mysterious, magical snowman. I mean, inside, aren't I just the same as regular people?
scripts.translation: 薑餅城的人都說我是神秘的魔法雪人，真奇怪。我是說，我的內心和普通人沒什麼不同吧？

scripts.text: I don't even know what I am. But even so, the people of Lutie try to accept me no matter what.
scripts.translation: 我甚至不知道自己是什麼。即便如此，薑餅城的人仍願意接納我。

scripts.text: ^3355FFPoze^000000 gave me his glamour photo with his address on it, and told me to visit him whenever I'm feeling blue. I was so happy to hear that...
scripts.translation: ^3355FF波澤^000000給了我一張他的帥照，上面寫著地址，還說我心情低落時可以去找他。聽到這些我很開心...

scripts.text: But then fate played its cruel joke on me once again, and I realized that I had no legs to visit him with.
scripts.translation: 可命運又和我開了個殘酷的玩笑：我沒有腿，根本沒法去拜訪他。

scripts.text: How did I ever get to this town? And how in the world am I able to talk?! I-It's not natural, is it? Does... Does that make me a monster?
scripts.translation: 我到底是怎麼來到這裡的？又怎麼會說話？！這...不正常吧？難道...難道我因此就成了魔物嗎？

scripts.text: ^3355FFSnowysnow is immersed in his deep thoughts, and seems^000000
^3355FFSnowysnow is immersed in his deep thoughts, and seems^000000
He's such an honest, good hearted guy. I hope he and Duffle get together someday.
scripts.translation: 他是個非常誠實、心地善良的人。我希望有一天他和達夫爾能走到一起。

scripts.text: Did I say that out loud? That was supposed to stay in my head! I'm soooo sorry! Boy, I can be a real dum-dum head, huh?
scripts.translation: 糟了~！我說出來了？這本來該藏在心裡的！真對不起！哎呀，我可真是個大笨蛋，對吧？

scripts.text: Poze is in love with Duffle. And she's kind to everybody, except for Poze.
scripts.translation: ..波澤喜歡達夫爾。而她除了對波澤之外，對誰都很好。

scripts.text: But I know that's because she likes him a whole whole lot! Hee hee hee!
scripts.translation: 但我知道，那是因為她非常喜歡他！嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Sure, he has a loud voice, doesn't take showers and smells like rotting food. But he's a funny guy with a warm heart. Everybody loves him!
scripts.translation: 他是嗓門大，不洗澡，身上還有股食物腐爛的味道。但他風趣又熱心，大家都喜歡他！

scripts.text: Of course, he still enjoys drinking strange things. They say it's a miracle that he doesn't have a tummyache. Hee hee~! Oh, I love that guy!
scripts.translation: 當然，他還是很喜歡喝奇怪的東西。聽說他沒鬧肚子真是個奇蹟。嘿嘿~！哦，我真喜歡那個人！

scripts.text: Yeah, she's a pickle expert, alright. Oh right, would you give this to her? I've been keeping the roughest salt in the world for her as a bit of a favor.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，她可是醃菜專家。對了，你能把這個帶給她嗎？我一直在幫她保管世界上最粗的鹽。

scripts.text: ^3355FFSnowysnow gave you the roughest salt in the world^000000.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雪雪給了你世界上最粗的^000000鹽。

scripts.text: I like her cooking because it's soooo delicious! Sometimes, she gives me grape syrup on snow flakes. Anyway, please deliver that salt for me, buddy~!
scripts.translation: 她做的東西太好吃了，我可喜歡了！有時，她還會給我吃淋上葡萄糖漿的雪花。總之，朋友，幫我把鹽送過去吧~！

scripts.text: Wow. Now, that's rough! Aunt Tachentze is always making pickles, so she sure could use it soon!
scripts.translation: ”哇，還真夠粗的！塔琴策阿姨一直在醃菜，肯定很快就要用了！

scripts.text: Hashokii, the boring clown? At first, he seems kind of dumb and not really that funny. But deep inside, he cares a lot about other people.
scripts.translation: 哈紹基，那個無聊的搞笑藝人？起初，他看起來有點傻，也不太搞笑。但內心深處，他很關心別人。

scripts.text: He's always trying his best to make those two orphans laugh and forget their troubles...
scripts.translation: 他總是盡力讓那兩個孤兒笑一笑，忘掉煩惱...

scripts.text: So you've met Charu Charu? That boy is so full of optimism and always looking forward. When he grows up, he's going to be a big shot!
scripts.translation: ..你見過查魯查魯了？他是個樂觀的男孩，總是向前看。長大後，他一定會成為大人物！

scripts.text: Thank you for listening to me so far. I really appreciate that you try to understand me, even though you're a stranger here.
scripts.translation: 謝謝你一直聽我說話。雖然你是這裡的陌生人，但我很感激你願意試著理解我。

scripts.text: Now, you know me better than anyone else in this town. So, in return, I want to give you a small present.
scripts.translation: 現在，你比這個城鎮裡的任何人都更瞭解我。作為回報，我想送你一份小禮物。

scripts.text: My dear friend, please visit me from time to time, so that we can chitchat, okay? See you soon! And Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation: 親愛的朋友，請時不時來找我聊天，好嗎？再見！聖誕快樂！

scripts.text: You're always welcome in Lutie, especially by me, Snowysnow! Happy Kwanza, Happy Hannukah and Merry Christmas~!
scripts.translation: 薑餅城隨時歡迎你，我雪雪更是歡迎！寬扎節快樂，光明節快樂，聖誕快樂~！

scripts.text: Around this wonderful town, eternally blessed with Christmas, there is a horrible dungeon, eternally cursed with Christmas.
scripts.translation: 這座奇妙的小鎮永遠受到聖誕的祝福，而鎮子附近那座可怕的地牢，卻永遠受到聖誕的詛咒。

scripts.text: I've heard that it's well decorated and looks just like a Toy Factory inside, where everything is so cute and pretty. They are Toy Soldiers and Gift Boxes as far as the eye can see!
scripts.translation: 我聽說裡面裝飾得很好，看起來就像玩具工廠的內部，一切都那麼可愛漂亮。放眼望去，全是玩具士兵和禮物盒！

scripts.text: Isn't that soooo exciting?! *Sigh* Even if it is a dungeon, I would like to go inside just to look. If only I was a real boy, or even had legs...
scripts.translation: 是不是很讓人興奮？！*嘆氣* 就算是地牢，我也想進去看看。要是我是個真正的男孩，或者哪怕有雙腿就好了...

scripts.text: Thank you for listening to me~
I'll see you again, someday! You'll always be in my heart~
scripts.translation: 總有一天再見面的！你永遠在我心裡~

scripts.text: Ooh, I'm trying to think of a good show to put on for Charu Charu and Marcell!
scripts.translation: 哼哼哼哼哼!哦，我正琢磨給查魯查魯和馬塞爾演個什麼好節目！

scripts.text: They are getting smarter and wittier everyday, and now it seems that they don't laugh at my best jokes anymore. How did they get to be so clever?
scripts.translation: 他們一天比一天聰明，越來越機靈了。現在，就連我最拿手的笑話也逗不笑他們了。他們怎麼變得這麼聰明啊？

scripts.text: Well, if I work hard enough, they can't help but laugh at my hilarious jokes! So... I better start inventing better jokes. Like, pronto.
scripts.translation: 只要我夠努力，他們一定會被我精彩的笑話逗得忍不住笑！所以...我得趕緊想些更好笑的笑話才行。

scripts.text: Ah ha! So you wanna learn more about Snowyshow! Let's see...
scripts.translation: 啊哈！你想多瞭解雪雪？讓我想想...

scripts.text: Well, there are two naughty kids,
^3355FF' Marcell '^000000. They attend my show regularly. I'm guessing you've heard the story from Cantata?
scripts.translation: ^3355FF經常來看我^000000的表演。我想，你已經聽康塔塔講過那個故事了吧？

scripts.text: Anyway, the two babies that were protected in Snowysnow's bosom? Yup, that's them. But Charu Charu and Marcell don't seem to know that Snowysnow saved them.
scripts.translation: 當年被雪雪護在懷裡的兩個嬰兒？對，就是他們。不過，查魯查魯和馬塞爾似乎還不知道，是雪雪救了他們。

scripts.text: Snowysnow told me the story of how he let his body fly into the air to block the giant fire ball that was about to hit them when they were babies. For their sake, he was willing to sacrifice himself.
scripts.translation: 雪雪告訴過我，當時有個巨大的火球就要砸中還是嬰兒的他們。他縱身飛起，替他們擋住了火球。為了他們，他甘願犧牲自己。

scripts.text: Why don't you go meet those 2 children? They might tell you the story we've never got the chance to hear. Okay then, good luck~! Bye bye!
scripts.translation: 去見見那兩個孩子吧？也許他們能講些我們還沒聽過的事。好啦，祝你好運~！再見！

scripts.text: Of course I know him! Anyone who doesn't know Snowysnow is a total stranger around here! Sometimes, he and I share a nice chat...
scripts.translation: 雪雪？我當然認識他！在這裡，不認識雪雪的肯定是外地人！我有時會和他聊聊天...

scripts.text: He makes such a good audience for my show. But to be honest, I'm not sure if he really likes it or not. Most people don't seem to care for my jokes.
scripts.translation: 他是個很捧場的觀眾。不過，說實話，我也不知道他是不是真的喜歡我的表演。大多數人好像都不喜歡我的笑話。

scripts.text: It totally baffles me! How could they not like the best jokes in the world?! Sheeeeesh~
scripts.translation: 真想不通！世界上最好笑的笑話，他們怎麼會不喜歡呢？！真是的~

scripts.text: You want to know more about Snowysnow? Ummm, I'm not that smart! Ask Marcell!
scripts.translation: 雪人！你想多瞭解雪雪？唔，我不太聰明！去問馬塞爾吧！

scripts.text: Did you talk to that clown guy over there? Isn't he soooooo booooring? (-.-)
scripts.translation: 你跟那邊那個搞笑藝人聊過了嗎？他是不是超級無敵無聊啊？(-.-)

scripts.text: When Marcell and I watch his show, we feel like we're getting dumber and dumber~
scripts.translation: 每次我和馬塞爾看他的表演，都覺得自己越來越笨了~

scripts.text: Charu Charu!! Watch your mouth! How dare you say that about poor Hashokii?! He's always trying hard to make us happy!
scripts.translation: 查魯查魯！別亂說話！你怎麼能這樣說可憐的哈紹基？！他一直都在努力逗我們開心！

scripts.text: But he's not funny at all!

scripts.translation: 我還是更想和^3355FF雪雪^000000待在一起~

scripts.text: Oh well, if you didn't visit Snowysnow yet, you should see him at least once. He's funny!
scripts.translation: 總之，如果你還沒見過雪雪，至少應該去看一次。他很有趣的！
祝你在薑餅城玩得盡興~！

scripts.text: He's a nice and funny guy!
And as Charu Charu always insists, he's funnier than Hashokii~ (But please don't let Hashokii know!)
scripts.translation: 查魯查魯總說，他比哈紹基更好玩~（可別告訴哈紹基哦！）

scripts.text: Well, Charu Charu and I are orphans, and don't remember our parents at all. We've been brought up by the people here in Lutie.
scripts.translation: 嗯，查魯查魯和我都是孤兒，完全不記得我們的父母。我們是被薑餅城這裡的人撫養長大的。

scripts.text: Uncle Cantata and Auntie Thachentze treated us like their own children, and Poze and Duffle have been like a brother and sister to us!
scripts.translation: 康塔塔叔叔和塔琴策阿姨把我們當親生孩子，波澤和達夫爾就像我們的哥哥姐姐！

scripts.text: They're all nice and generous, and we always appreciate what they've done to take care of us.
scripts.translation: 他們都很好，也很慷慨，我們一直感激他們照顧我們。

scripts.text: I also heard Snowysnow doesn't have a mommy or daddy too. And I also heard Snowysnow and us weren't born here, but somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 我還聽說雪雪也沒有爸爸媽媽。而且我還聽說雪雪和我們不是出生在這裡，而是在別的地方。

scripts.text: I've heard that Snowysnow and us actually come from the same place, although I'm not sure yet. But I know that Snowysnow and me have the same kind of burns on our body.
scripts.translation: 聽說雪雪和我們來自同一個地方，不過我還不確定。但我知道，雪雪和我身上有一樣的燒傷。

scripts.text: Charu Charu and I have these old burns on our backs, and Snowysnow has a dark smudge on his tummy. So I think we got burned all at the same time...
scripts.translation: 查魯查魯和我背上都有舊燒傷，雪雪肚子上也有一塊黑色的印記。所以我想，我們大概是同時被燒傷的...

scripts.text: You wanna learn all about Snowysnow because you want to become his friend! He'll be so happy to know that! Ooh! Maybe he'll give you a present! Good luck!
scripts.translation: 你想了解雪雪的一切，是因為想和他交朋友！他知道了一定會很高興！噢！說不定還會送你禮物！祝你好運！

scripts.text: More than anybody else, you know the most about Snowysnow! Please talk to Mr.Snowysnow, he'll be happy to know you care about him. Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation: 你比誰都瞭解雪雪！去和雪雪先生聊聊吧，他知道你這麼關心他，一定很高興。聖誕快樂！

scripts.text: It's freezing out here...! And Charu Charu makes me colder with his unbearable jokes. And the wind's blowing so hard!
scripts.translation: 外面好冷啊...！而且查魯查魯那些讓人受不了的笑話讓我更冷了。風還颳得這麼大！

scripts.text: You know what? Snowysnow has a special power. He can make as many presents as Santa Claus! Isn't that great?
scripts.translation: 你知道嗎？雪雪有一種特殊的能力。他能像聖誕老人一樣變出很多禮物！是不是很厲害？

scripts.text: Huh? What's that look on your face for? Snowysnow has a big gift bag inside of his body, and gives gifts whenever he feels like it. What's so hard to believe about that?
scripts.translation: 咦？你這是什麼表情？雪雪的身體裡有一個大大的禮物袋，想送禮物就隨時能送出來。這有什麼難以置信的嗎？
